bio.label: About
bio.title:
Detroit's
drum chair
bio.text: Sean Dobbins keeps time for Detroit. Two decades on the city's best bandstands beside Benny Golson, Dr. Lonnie Smith, Barry Harris and Mose Allison, and now the jazz drumset studio at Indiana University's Jacobs School of Music, where the next ones are learning to swing.

barbershop.title: From The Barbershop
barbershop.blurb: Sean's studio at IU, and a library of free PDFs for drummers everywhere.
barbershop.asideText: Jazz drumset at the Indiana University Jacobs School of Music. Audition info, what the studio is like, and a form if you want Sean to know you're coming.
